meta.title: feat: Prefetch info panel data with config options `prefetchObjects` and `prefetchStale`
meta.body_summary: Prefetch info panel data when browsing sequential rows; add config options `prefetchObjects` and `prefetchStale`.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI Codex added prefetch/cache for info panel; coderabbitai flagged scoping and error handling issues; all resolved before merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 296 changed lines across 4 files, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, concentrated in DataBrowser.react.js. It fits a incremental performance feature that merged after automated review identified correctness issues.

review_details.concern_detail: CodeRabbit flagged that variable declarations in switch cases could be accessed from other cases, and recommended wrapping in blocks; also recommended .catch for prefetch cloud function calls.
review_details.performance_claim: Prefetching cloud function results when browsing sequential rows reduces latency and provides faster info panel load.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Prefetch/caching with stale invalidation in a React dashboard; code required attention to variable scoping, error handling, and cache size limits, which were caught by static analysis.

detection_detail.code_reading: CodeRabbit performed static analysis (Biome) that flagged variable scoping issues and missing error handling, leading to fixes in PR.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or timing data provided; only narrative claim of improved browsing responsiveness.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Fixes for scoping, error handling, and documentation were added in subsequent commits before merge.

core_change_summary.description: Added prefetch/caching of cloud function results in DataBrowser.react.js for sequential row browsing; new config options prefetchObjects and prefetchStale control number of objects to prefetch and staleness duration; simplified cell click handler in BrowserCell.react.js.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: README.md was updated to document new config options.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added prefetch logic, cache, stale check, and config propagation (ecdf280).
Added arrow key navigation support for prefetching (8c1c12b).
Fixed key case scoping issues flagged by coderabbitai (13ab40d).
Added error handling for prefetch failures (0ebd007).
Fixed info panel reload on cell click despite cached data (4c382b3).

review_signals.summary: Requested adding trailing pipes to table rows in README.md to fix Markdown rendering.
Recommended adding .catch block for prefetch cloud function calls to avoid silent failures.
Flagged variable declaration scoping issues in switch cases due to no block wrapping; recommended wrapping in blocks.
review_signals.action_taken: Fixed key case scopes in commit 13ab40d.

collaboration_trajectory: OpenAI Codex opened PR with prefetch feature and no benchmark.
CodeRabbit bot flagged variable scoping, missing error handling, and markdown formatting issues.
Author (mtrezza) fixed scoping, added error handling, fixed markdown, and addressed cache growth bound.
Review dismissed after fixes; PR merged.
